verdict.rationale: The timeouts documentation states that under the `return-partial` deadline mode, a request with no usable result fails without a charge. That is one documented billing rule for one type of failed request. The pack has no general policy on whether errors, blocked or opted-out sites, or empty results count against quota. Missing for 10: a documented billing policy for failed/errored requests, for blocked or robots/opt-out-restricted targets, and for empty-result responses across endpoints, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of no-charge behavior.
